description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves CURSE OF THE WULFEN (WP-S2): while within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model and not battle-shocked, an INFANTRY unit with the ability has +1 OC. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active: the Wulfen (OC 0 on their datasheet) stand on objective NML_1 with the Wolf Guard Battle Leader ~3" away. (1) Loading the save checks objective control at the start of the Command phase: every Wulfen model has OC 1, so the Space Wolves control NML_1 — the marker's label and the Command panel read Space Wolves. (2) Setup privilege: the Battle Leader is moved 10" away (no Wolf Priest within 12") and objective control is re-checked: the Wulfen are back to OC 0 and NML_1 reads Uncontrolled. (3) Setup privilege: the Wolf Priest is placed 9" from the Wulfen (within 12", not 6"): the curse is on again and NML_1 returns to the Space Wolves.

steps.comment: every Wulfen model has OC 1 (0 +1 Curse of the Wulfen)
steps.script:
var u = GameState.state.units["U_WULFEN_A"]
var t = 0
for m in u.models:
	t += MissionManager.model_oc(u, m)
print("[sw11e curse] Wulfen total OC = ", t, " source = ", load("res://scripts/codex/space_wolves/SWArmyRules11e.gd").curse_source(u))
return t

steps.comment: the board marker reads the controlling faction
the Command panel's OBJECTIVE CONTROL list
setup privilege: the Battle Leader steps 10" away; objective control re-checked
steps.script:
var H = load("res://tests/helpers/cus11e_c5_scen.gd")
H.move_to("U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A", 24.0, 16.0)
MissionManager.check_all_objectives()
return true

var u = GameState.state.units["U_WULFEN_A"]
var t = 0
for m in u.models:
	t += MissionManager.model_oc(u, m)
return t

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Wolf Priest 9" from the Wulfen (within 12", not 6")
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
